notes:
- New: play the top card of a library when a card allows it (Xanathar, Guild Kingpin; Future Sight; Oracle of Mul Daya), including spending mana as though it were any type.
- New: Wish, Burning Wish and Learn get cards from your sideboard.
- New: Emrakul, the Promised End and other mind control: you play the opponent's turn.
- New: choices Forge asks itself are now buttons: Bloodthorn Flail's equip cost (pay or discard), Butcher of the Horde's keyword, tap or untap (Sewer-veillance Cam).
- Fix: Brawl, Premodern and Timeless can be picked in friend challenges (the deck type jumped back to Standard or Legacy).
- Fix: Gemstone Caverns and other questions without Arena wording no longer show a blank prompt.
- Fix: X is asked before mana is tapped (Kozilek's Command).
- Fix: mana symbols show as icons in Forge's own buttons and questions.
- Fix: MTGA Forge now checks that MTG Arena has downloaded its UI text and sounds (sign in to Arena once first), which caused missing labels and no sound.
